name: @stufen/ui-kit
provides: src/styles.css (the --st-* variables for light and dark, and the st- component classes)
FeedbackFab (open state can be controlled by the host with open and onOpenChange)
AudioButton (audio element or speech synthesis, states idle, playing and error)
ExerciseRenderer and RENDERABLE_TYPES (multiple_choice, cloze, match_pairs, order_words, flashcard, read_answer, listen_answer, dictation)
emptyValue and isComplete for the eight renderable exercise types
local payload and response types for the eight renderable exercise types (ExercisePayloadMap, ExerciseValueMap, ExerciseResult, ExerciseRendererProps)
'use client' directive on every interactive component and every exercise renderer, so a React Server Component can import them from the entry
